Hi Amelia,

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday — thanks again for the time. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Lumina that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and two provisional cutover windows. High level:

- UAT / canary traffic start: week of 2027-06-20 (target: Mon 2027-06-21)
- Full prod cutover target: 2027-07-06 to 2027-07-08 (week of 2027-07-04)
- Key milestones: SOW sign, provisioned dedicated capacity, security questionnaire closure, UAT verification, data-retention & logging confirmation.

Could you confirm:
1) Procurement/SOW review owner and typical SLA for legal here?
2) Any blackout windows in June/July for Lumina?
3) If the cutover windows look feasible from your side — we can lock dates and assign internal owners.

Attachments: Lumina_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (draft MAP, milestone table)

If that looks good I'll pull Naomi (CS lead) and Ben (Tech lead) into the MAP conversation to assign specific checkpoints and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks for the MAP, this is exactly the structure we like. A few quick items from Lumina side:

- Procurement: procurement@lumina.ai will take the SOW. Typical internal review SLA is 7–10 business days once legal has an initial version.
- Blackout windows: none in early June, but leadership is on a company offsite 2027-06-29 to 2027-07-02 — we cannot do any changes then.
- Data retention milestone: we need the final data-retention policy confirmed by 2027-07-12 (we can do UAT earlier, but retention/archival policy is a late gating item for compliance).

On the dates: we can start UAT/canary on 2027-06-21 as proposed; full cutover 2027-07-06 is good provided data-retention milestone is accepted by 2027-07-12 (we're fine with the cutover as long as archival acceptance can be completed within a short follow-up window).

I've cc'd procurement to start the SOW intake. Naomi — happy to coordinate a quick call next week to walk through acceptance criteria (our PMs prefer a 30-min checklist review).

Thanks,
Amelia Wong
VP Product Operations
